subject: balloon
name: 气球
label: 心形气球
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One heart-shaped balloon with a tiny tied neck and long loose curling string.
Pure black contour line art, smooth blank interiors, no shading or gray fills, complete silhouette within clear margins. STRICT: the ONLY object is a heart-shaped balloon and its string. Nothing holds it. No animal, dog, person, character or other object anywhere. Place one plain heart balloon in the upper center with one flowing string below.
